mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_bg_image (MEMBER_ID, IMG_URL, SORT_ORDER, POS_X, POS_Y, BG_SIZE) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{imgUrl}, #{sortOrder}, COALESCE(#{posX}, 50), COALESCE(#{posY}, 50), COALESCE(#{bgSize}, 120))
mapper.select: SELECT BG_IMG_ID AS bgImgId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, IMG_URL AS imgUrl, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, POS_X AS posX, POS_Y AS posY, BG_SIZE AS bgSize FROM member_bg_image WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE member_bg_image SET SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, POS_X = COALESCE(#{posX}, 50), POS_Y = COALESCE(#{posY}, 50), BG_SIZE = COALESCE(#{bgSize}, 120) WHERE BG_IMG_ID = #{bgImgId}
